research_integrity: This is a new mathematical derivation grounded in publicly accessible literature, not an independent certification or attribution of authorship. Related prior periodic-firing theorems are credited; possible implicit equivalence in unindexed literature remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary synchronous parallel firing on bidirected stars only, with arbitrary nonnegative initial chip counts. No claims for general trees or other graph orientations. An exact case analysis proves all parameters; finite calculations check bounded instances and do not independently validate the proof.
title: Avalanche complexes of bidirected stars: exact facets, a sharp synchronization threshold, and degree-zero persistence
